title: Important 2026 Update

body:
Dear friends,

2026 is a special year for me. I look forward to completing two books and some projects with the [Center for Action and Contemplation](https://cac.org/about/cac-faculty/brian-d-mclaren) and [ZOEoncampus.com](https://www.zoeoncampus.com/).

The Great Rift, the second book in my [Last Voyage trilogy](/archive/the-last-voyage-my-new-sci-fi-novel), will release in the fall, and I plan to announce a few dates for podcast and media interviews relating to the book in September. Around that time, I also hope to announce my plans for public speaking in 2027-2029. I'll share these and other updates here on my blog, brianmclaren.net.

I will only have two public appearances this year, at [Southern Lights](https://southernlightsconference.com/) in late January and on [Sanibel Island](https://www.saintmichaels-sanibel.org/) in early February.

Apart from these commitments, I will be taking a sabbatical — to spend time with family, celebrate my 70th birthday, address some health issues, and enjoy the gift of life without a pressured schedule.

As a result, I won't be able to take on any new projects (reading/endorsing manuscripts, public speaking, etc.) between now and the end of 2026. Nor will I be able to respond to emails, except on a very limited basis, and will be largely absent from social media. I'm sorry for any inconvenience, and I thank you for understanding.

Blessings to each of you!

With love, warm greetings, and gratitude,
Brian
